description: Plays one of the Tracker's synths, putting out its notes as pitch, gate, velocity and panning and its eight modulation channels as CV

params.text: Chooses which of the track's synths this module plays, by number from 0 to 99; the small display beside it names them

outputs.text: The pitch of each voice of the chosen synth, one polyphonic channel per voice
The gate of each voice, one polyphonic channel per voice; whether it holds until a note stop or only pulses is the gate mode set on that synth in the Tracker
The velocity written on each note, 0V at 0 and 10V at 99, smoothed as it changes
The panning written on each note, -5V hard left, 0V centre and 5V hard right, smoothed as it changes
One of the eight modulation channels of the chosen synth, scaled into the range set for it on the menu

notes: nothing comes out of this until a Tracker module is somewhere in the patch; the two are joined through the plugin rather than by a cable, so where it goes in the rack does not matter.
a synth with this module's number has to exist in the track; with a number no synth uses, the outputs hold whatever they last had.
the number of polyphonic channels on the note outputs, and the gate mode, are set on the synth in the Tracker's pattern view, and the update button there applies the change.
more than one of these can be pointed at the same synth, which is how one modulation channel can be taken at two different voltage ranges at once.
menu: CV 1 — sets the lowest and highest voltage the first modulation channel is scaled into, and maps that channel onto up to four knobs on other modules
CV 2 — sets the lowest and highest voltage the second modulation channel is scaled into, and maps that channel onto up to four knobs on other modules
CV 3 — sets the lowest and highest voltage the third modulation channel is scaled into, and maps that channel onto up to four knobs on other modules
CV 4 — sets the lowest and highest voltage the fourth modulation channel is scaled into, and maps that channel onto up to four knobs on other modules
CV 5 — sets the lowest and highest voltage the fifth modulation channel is scaled into, and maps that channel onto up to four knobs on other modules
CV 6 — sets the lowest and highest voltage the sixth modulation channel is scaled into, and maps that channel onto up to four knobs on other modules
CV 7 — sets the lowest and highest voltage the seventh modulation channel is scaled into, and maps that channel onto up to four knobs on other modules
CV 8 — sets the lowest and highest voltage the eighth modulation channel is scaled into, and maps that channel onto up to four knobs on other modules
